## Search and TikTok pairing (original concept; no media uploaded)
- Question hook: “A letter appeared on the screen. Why did people say it wasn't there?”
- Reveal: 1992 lab task had a narrow vulnerable window; task conditions can change the result.
- Research twist: consecutive targets can escape the effect; scientists still debate mechanisms.
- Responsible closing: “Look up Raymond, Shapiro and Arnell (1992). The test is real. One mechanism is not settled.”
- Landing: deep source article, not direct monetization.
- Word prohibitions: “brainhack guaranteed,” “cure anxiety,” “Zen12 proven to sharpen attention,” “all witnesses lie.”

## A/B experiment (HYPOTHESIS, NOT LIVE)
Pre-register before publication: A is useful source guide in text; B is identical guide plus optional **40s original educational film** with first-party-hosted MP4, poster, captions, visible HTML transcript, manual playback and no embedded third party. Primary metric: coarse outbound-intent rate among guide visits; secondary: read-through rate. No raw referrer, IP, URL, identity, session, click ID or purchase data. Use only approved, pre-aggregated categorical metrics; do not join to buyer records. Minimum reportable cell >=20, with reviewer assessment of inference/differencing risk. Start with no analytics until written authorization and privacy review. Even after activation, clicks are *not* sales. Never assume the film is superior; performance budget and accessible no-JS state matter.

## Video production gate
Storyboard and VTT are concepts only, **not a rendered film**. No play button or pretend thumbnail that implies working playback. First-party static media, captions/audio alignment, poster rights, compression, WCAG captions, contrast, keyboard, reduced-motion and browser tests are prerelease conditions. No autoplay/preload-before-interaction. A must remain valid without B.

## Release gates and ownership
- Mind lane: article, buyer guide, claim register, isolated HTML pilot, synthetic measurement model.
- Homepage art lead: review only for portal alignment; does not edit PR #49/Issue #150 from this lane.
- Site QA #126: independent claims/disclosure/a11y/policy and viewport review.
- Dispatch #174: review future guide destination and channel permissions; **do not modify unsent newsletter issues**.
- Founder: explicit publishing/merchant activation authorization after source and technical clearance.
